description: The NEGATIVE of `ol-var-not-visible`, and the reason the two codes are distinguishable at all: a procedure reading a name that NO scope binds anywhere raises the ordinary `ol-undefined-var` (spec/error-model.md:102 — "every failed read the sealed procedure boundary is not the cause of"). Added at @testing's request during the review gate, which measured that an implementation reporting `ol-var-not-visible` for EVERY failed read inside a procedure passed all 984 fixtures: the boundary code was pinned only in its positive direction, so nothing in the stack-neutral corpus said when NOT to report it. The one existing fixture pairing `ol-undefined-var` with a `define` is check-only and reads at the top level, so it never reaches this runtime path.
